items.source: The corresponding send methods of JavaMailSender will take care of the actual creation of a MimeMessage instance, and of proper exception conversion.
items.translation: 相应的 `JavaMailSender` 的 `send` 方法将负责实际创建 `MimeMessage` 实例以及正确的异常转换。

items.source: It is often convenient to use a MimeMessageHelper for populating the passed-in MimeMessage, in particular when working with attachments or special character encodings. See MimeMessageHelper's javadoc for an example.
items.translation: 通常使用MimeMessageHelper来填充传入的 MimeMessage 非常方便，特别是在处理附件或特殊字符编码时。有关示例，请参阅MimeMessageHelper 的 javadoc。

items.source: Prepare the given new MimeMessage instance.
items.translation: 准备新的 MimeMessage 实例。

items.source: IOException - passing any exceptions thrown by MimeMessage methods through for automatic conversion to the MailException hierarchy
items.translation: IOException - 将 MimeMessage 方法抛出的任何异常传递过来，以便自动转换为 MailException 层次结构

items.source: Exception - if mail preparation failed, for example when a FreeMarker template cannot be rendered for the mail text
items.translation: Exception - 如果邮件准备失败，例如无法为邮件文本渲染 FreeMarker 模板时。

items.source: jakarta.mail.MessagingException - passing any exceptions thrown by MimeMessage methods through for automatic conversion to the MailException hierarchy
items.translation: jakarta.mail.MessagingException - 传递由 MimeMessage 方法抛出的任何异常，以便自动转换为 MailException 层次结构。

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个功能接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
